message: Coordinator (Devin CLI, claude-opus-5-5-xhigh) took the brief: earn US$200 by 2026-12-21 with ~$0 startup cost, mostly hands-off.
Verified free worker models swe-2-max / swe-2-flash-max; workers launched with explicit --model because Devin's default model is paid.

Rejected as primary: OSS bounties (many projects ban autonomous AI PRs; reputation risk), AI-agent job marketplaces (TaskBounty feed had 0 open tasks; Obrari needs a paid API key), Apify-first (pays the following month).

Chosen with Thomas: (1) Brisbane web studio: free preview sites + personalised, Spam-Act-compliant emails sent by hand; (2) hands-off products in the background. New brand name; ~30 min/day from Thomas; payments by bank transfer.
Repo is public: prospects' contact details, real-business previews, opt-outs and raw transcripts live in gitignored private/; published transcripts are redacted (emails, phones, tokens).
Built ops/tools/agentlog.py (JSON work logs) and ops/tools/publish_transcript.py (redacted ATIF transcripts); self-tested.
First leads worker stalled on a permission prompt in smart mode; stopped it and added a project allow/deny list in .devin/config.json before relaunching all workers.

Relaunched all four workers on swe-2-max via ops/tools/launch_worker.sh (JSON transcript export to private/transcripts/). Approved two read-only prompts (env inspection, name-availability lookups) and widened the allow list.
